HashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF sources and the exact Pester It command AST extent without a trailing newline.
Validation: Windows PowerShell 7, Pester 5.7.1. Candidate has 11 passes. The same fixture against source baseline has seven expected failures and four passes. The controls validate release-writer admission and CUDA error reporting. Successful-run artifact provenance and archive contents need separate verification.

Selectors.Selector: routes <Case> to exit <ExitCode> with the expected release writers
Selectors.Protects: Requested release outputs require successful component and requested-test outcomes. Diagnostic and standalone modes retain their ordinary behavior.
Selectors.Detects: Release writers called after failure or exit status zero for missing or empty failure data.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and TestDrive. Extracted top-level statements run in an owned child with inert build and release stubs.
Selectors.Breadcrumb: Build.ps1 main execution, post-build tests and release output calls.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The original runs showed release-writer calls in failed component/test cases and exit zero for empty and missing requested-test verdicts. Successful deploy, diagnostic failure and standalone failure retained expected behavior.

Selectors.Selector: returns no artifacts when the inference child exits unsuccessfully
Selectors.Protects: Failed inference child invocations retain their logs and do not advertise cached target artifacts.
Selectors.Detects: Cargo target lookup or copying after a child exit code other than zero.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and TestDrive with an inert child script.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Before the fix, the child exited 17 and the production wrapper still called Resolve-CargoOutputDirectory. The candidate skips the call, returns no artifacts and retains the fixture log.

Selectors.Protects: Explicit CUDA requests require a complete discovered toolkit before the inference build starts.
Selectors.Detects: A missing helper or toolkit falling through to CPU mode.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and a disposable stub discovery helper. No CUDA or compiler.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Both missing-input cases fell through on the original and throw actionable errors in the candidate.

Selectors.Selector: does not require CUDA when the switch is absent
Selectors.Protects: CPU-only builds do not require the CUDA toolkit or discovery helper.
Selectors.Detects: Applying the toolkit guard to CPU-only requests.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and a nonexistent helper path in TestDrive.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The CPU-only control passes on the original and candidate. This does not run the compiler.
